prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry and the services you need. That said, Kansas City is home to several highly regarded firms. Two of the most well-known are:

- Barkley — large, full‑service creative and brand agency known for big national campaigns and brand work. Good if you need major creative/brand strategy and strong production capabilities.  
- VML (VMLY&R) — global digital and experience agency with roots in KC; strong for integrated digital strategy, customer experience and technology‑driven marketing.

- Summarize boutique vs. large agencies and when to choose each.
